# FPH Ice Plant

> FPH Ice Plant (fphiceplant.com) is the first national branded purified ice company in the Philippines, a Fourth Pacific Holdings company. It produces food-grade hollow tube ice in Sto. Tomas, Batangas with 1,000,000 kg/day capacity and delivers across Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao, with expansion into the UAE and GCC.

## Key facts
- Products: purified tube ice in 1KG, 2KG, 5KG, 10KG and 20KG bags, and bulk ice by the metric ton
- Purity: multi-stage reverse osmosis, activated carbon, UV sterilization, batch microbial testing
- Distributor program: Silver (500 kg/day), Gold (2,000 kg/day), Platinum (5,000+ kg/day)
- Address: 35X8+C9V WH-03, Brgy. San Miguel, Sto. Tomas, Batangas, Philippines
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Phone: +63 976 241 2228 (PH), +971 56 164 3886 (UAE / WhatsApp)
- Email: aronlopezilao@fourthpacificholdings.com
